signal_path.crossover: two one-pole lowpasses at 500 Hz and 4000 Hz; low=lp500, mid=lp4000-lp500, high=input-lp4000
signal_path.delay: shared three-band power-of-two ring buffers with linear fractional-delay interpolation
signal_path.ramp: per-sample linear interpolation of delay, band amplitudes and direction over the D121h ramp length
signal_path.stereo: equal-power pan from clamped direction X
signal_path.mix: wet-only; dry ownership remains outside this renderer

safety.endpoint_energy_rule: sum of squared slot amplitudes for each band must be <=1 at both ramp endpoints
safety.incomplete_policy: D121h supplies fade-to-zero slots; renderer never invents reflections
